summary: Tested Instagram OAuth 2.0 multi-tenant implementation. All backend APIs working (12/12 pass). Frontend correctly handles not-configured state and OAuth callback parameters.

instagram_oauth_start.behavior: Returns 503 with 'Instagram integration not configured' when INSTAGRAM_APP_ID not set - expected behavior per docs

instagram_oauth_callback.behavior: Validates required params (code, state), handles invalid state with redirect to frontend with ig_error param

instagram_token_refresh.behavior: Requires auth, returns 404 when no connection exists

instagram_media.behavior: Requires auth, accepts limit param, returns 404 when no connection

instagram_profile.behavior: Requires auth, returns 404 when no connection

verified: Connect button shows 'Instagram not configured. Contact administrator.' toast on 503
ig_error callback param shows 'Instagram authentication error.' toast
ig_success callback param shows 'Instagram connected: @username' toast
URL params cleaned from browser URL after handling

seed_data_creation: None - Testing OAuth flow which requires real Meta App credentials
context_for_next_testing_agent: Instagram OAuth 2.0 is fully implemented but requires real Meta App credentials (INSTAGRAM_APP_ID, INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET in backend/.env) to function. Without credentials, endpoints correctly return 503 'not configured'. Documentation at /app/docs/INSTAGRAM_SETUP.md explains setup process.
